conditioning_tests.scope: Finite half patterns in selected operand combinations, not every possible combination. Explicit round-to-nearest per operation.

limitations: Finite-input equivalence to existing student arithmetic, not native quality.
Complete student graph timings exclude D3D12 integration and do not accelerate native NVIDIA execution.
Exact full-image results cover only the checked checkpoints, inputs and environment.
Intervals average ten consecutive graph replays; p95 is an interval-average percentile, not per-frame tail latency.
Measured execution of experimental students plus grade, excluding D3D12 integration. No native-runtime acceleration.
One static input and one device; other desktop GPU work is not controlled.

paired_capture.scope: Four static fenced frames check observer equality, not temporal/game quality. Observer CPU timings include logging and cannot measure batching benefit.

limitations: Observes the intercepted command-list implementations on the calling thread; not proof of all commands, worker threads or implicit driver operations.
Legacy barriers are recorded without restricting resources to the two-buffer registry. Enhanced calls retain group metadata, not resource payloads.
A barrier between single launches cannot simply be moved into or across a combined chain.
Packed-argument lifetime and multi-kernel chain memory semantics remain unverified. No executable batch plan or native speedup is claimed.
Only frames with matching color, depth and motion can test output equality. Later separately launched sample frames can have different temporal inputs.
Observer CPU durations include synchronous logging and are not performance measurements.
Quality remains unproven and no student is installed. Static first-reset examples do not establish temporal/game acceptance.
The new pair matches architecture, seed, optimizer, 4500 updates, 9000 sampled examples and equal scene/photo weighting. Only the additional sixteen photo slots differ.
Repeated-low control has 62 sampling slots but 46 distinct inputs; brighter run has 62 distinct inputs. No new photo identity is introduced.
The same sixteen validation frames remain excluded, but their earlier errors informed the data experiment. They are not a final independent test set.
Existing fusions are validated on new weights; no new inference kernel or native acceleration is claimed.
Full-1080p student-plus-grade CUDA graph timings exclude D3D12 integration; reported intervals average ten replays.
Native observer matched output is proven only on first-reset frame0; later paired runs have different color/motion inputs.
Barrier ordering alone does not establish complete command coverage, packed-argument lifetime or multi-kernel chain memory semantics.
Eighteen hidden sample runs used the existing inactive private Windows desktop. Game, driver and production runtime are unchanged.
